summary: Tested /inscricao/pagamento/pix radical strategy (img src + XHR text). Backend endpoints /api/pix/qr.png and /api/pix/code.txt work perfectly (200 image/png 2620B, 200 text/plain 161 chars). Found and fixed a frontend robustness bug: readLS() JSON.parses localStorage values, converting numeric strings (e.g. CPF '11122233344', protocolo '123456789000') into JS numbers, causing '(cpf||"").replace is not a function' pageerror and preventing QR generation. Fix: String() coercion for nome/cpf/protocolo/cargoTxt. After fix, exact test scenario passes: QR image loads (naturalWidth=392), PIX code 161 chars starting '00020101021126440014br.gov.bcb.pix0122danielmmm950@gmail.com...', all buttons (COPIAR/VOLTAR/IMPRIMIR) present, user data (Nome/CPF/Cargo/Valor/Protocolo) displayed.
action_items: (Applied) String coercion in readLS consumers to prevent JSON.parse converting numeric strings to numbers. Consider making readLS itself preserve strings by default or only parse when value looks like JSON ('{','[').
critical_code_review_comments: readLS() blindly JSON.parses every localStorage value. This is fragile: numeric strings like '11122233344' become numbers, breaking any .replace()/.slice() calls downstream. Better approach: only attempt JSON.parse if value starts with '{' or '['.
requestfailed on /api/track/pix-generated (ERR_ABORTED) — non-blocking analytics but should be investigated (may be blocked by adblock/preflight).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PIX page now works with img src + XHR strategy. Both endpoints verified via curl and browser. Small String() coercion fix applied to handle numeric localStorage values. If issues re-appear check readLS() JSON.parse behavior.
rca of the issue: Original test scenario used numeric-string localStorage values ('11122233344','123456789000'). readLS() calls JSON.parse on each localStorage value; numeric strings parse to JS numbers. Line 308 then called (cpf||'').replace(/\D/g,''), throwing TypeError since Number has no .replace. gerarPix() aborted before creating , so QR frame stayed at 'Carregando QR...'. Fix: coerce loaded values to String() at read time.
